title: Explicit Ext constructor for a derived coefficient arrow
statement: For an abelian category C with its supplied Ext smallness and derived category, finiteArrowClass sends a degree-n derived single-to-shifted-single arrow f to Ext.homEquiv inverse(f). Its derived representative is f. For finite-realization data, finiteRealizedClass equals finiteArrowClass of its explicit single/source, exact functor, shift and line composite. All data are explicit; the two identities are proved.

source.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension

proof.text: Define finiteArrowClass by Ext.homEquiv inverse, prove its hom formula by inverse cancellation, and unfold the two explicit Ext constructors to prove the class equality.
